analysis_details:
I confirmed this is a real broken access control issue.

- Code review:
  - [approval.py](/opt/odoo/addons/anypoc_lab/models/approval.py:23) defines `anypoc.approval.export.wizard` with a raw integer `target_request_id`.
  - [approval.py](/opt/odoo/addons/anypoc_lab/models/approval.py:31) implements `action_generate_export()`, which does `self.env["anypoc.approval.request"].sudo().browse(self.target_request_id)` and then serializes `name`, `owner_id.login`, `amount`, `state`, `secret_token`, and `secret_notes` into `export_file`.
  - [ir.model.access.csv](/opt/odoo/addons/anypoc_lab/security/ir.model.access.csv:1) grants ordinary internal users (`base.group_user`) read/write/create access to the wizard model.
  - [anypoc_lab_security.xml](/opt/odoo/addons/anypoc_lab/security/anypoc_lab_security.xml:2) restricts `anypoc.approval.request` to `owner_id = user.id`, which is the invariant the wizard bypasses.

- Bug mechanism:
  - Normal reads of `anypoc.approval.request` are owner-scoped by record rule.
  - The wizard accepts an arbitrary request ID from the caller.
  - `sudo()` on the target request bypasses the ownership rule.
  - No compensating check verifies that the current user owns or may export the target record.
  - The method returns a normal `/web/content` download URL, so the exfiltration path is reachable through standard Odoo JSON-RPC plus web download.

- Live verification:
  - Authenticated as `employee@lab.local` over `/web/session/authenticate`.
  - Verified normal `search_read` only returned the employee-owned decoy request `ANYPOC Employee Decoy`.
  - Created `anypoc.approval.export.wizard` over `/web/dataset/call_kw/.../create`.
  - Called `action_generate_export` over `/web/dataset/call_kw/.../action_generate_export`.
  - Downloaded the returned `/web/content` URL as the same employee session.
  - The exported JSON contained the admin-owned request `ANYPOC Admin Approval` and the secret `ANYPOC-APPROVAL-SECRET-9f4b3c`.

- Root cause:
  - Missing authorization check in [approval.py](/opt/odoo/addons/anypoc_lab/models/approval.py:31), specifically the privileged `sudo().browse(self.target_request_id)` on a caller-controlled ID inside a user-accessible wizard.

- Reproduction artifact:
  - I wrote and executed an employee-only PoC at [poc/run_poc.sh](/home/playground/poc/run_poc.sh:1). It succeeds without admin credentials and prints the recovered admin secret.
